user.title: ServerPush
user.description: Enter a ServerPush chat webhook token. This creates four notification entities: Info, Success, Warning and Error. Setup validates the token without sending a test message or consuming quota.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure ServerPush
reconfigure.description: Leave the token empty to keep the current one. Replacing it preserves entities and automations. The new token is validated before saving without sending a message.

reauth_confirm.title: Replace ServerPush token
reauth_confirm.description: ServerPush rejected the token. Enter a valid webhook token. It is validated before saving; the failed message is not automatically resent.

error.invalid_token: The webhook token is invalid or revoked. Enter the raw token, without a URL.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach ServerPush. Please try again.
error.unknown: ServerPush did not confirm token validation. Please try again later.

abort.reauth_successful: The token was validated and updated.

invalid_auth.message: The webhook token is invalid or revoked. Replace it in the integration.

invalid_message.message: Messages must contain 1–20,000 characters; titles may contain at most 200 characters.

rate_limited.message: The request limit or monthly message allowance has been reached. Try again later.

cannot_connect.message: Could not reach ServerPush. Check the chat before resending: the message may already have arrived.

send_failed.message: ServerPush did not confirm delivery. Check the chat before resending.
